sum_insured_options: ₹3L (illustrated); range not fully specified in wording

room_rent.display: Single Private AC Room or 1% of SI/day
room_rent.note: Policy Schedule specifies either 'Single Private AC Room' or 'up to 1% of SI per day'. Optional Benefit: Room Rent and ICU Modification can upgrade to No Sub-limit for SI>=5L.

icu.display: Up to 2% of SI/day or No Sub-limit
icu.note: Base plan offers either 2% of SI per day or No Sub-limit depending on Policy Schedule. Optional Benefit can upgrade to No Sub-limit.

copayment.display: None (base); 10% extra if eldest insured >70 yrs under voluntary co-pay
copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment in base plan. Optional Benefit: Voluntary Co-payment allows insured to choose a co-pay; if entry/renewal age >70, additional 10% co-pay applies over selected amount. Smart Select optional adds 20% co-pay for non-network hospitals.

sub_limits.note: Base plan has no disease/procedure sub-limits. Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Specified Diseases can add caps on cataract, knee replacement, CVA/CVD, cancer, renal diseases, long bone fractures. Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Advance Technology Methods and Sub-limit on Hospitalization related Expenses also available.

deductible.note: Deductible is an optional feature; if opted, it applies before benefits are payable. Base plan has no deductible.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement date.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 12 months from inception. Optional Benefit: Increase in PED Waiting Period can extend this. Optional Benefit: Instant Cover can waive PED waiting for Diabetes/Hypertension/Hyperlipidemia/Asthma at first issuance.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, BPH, etc.) have 24-month waiting period.

maternity.note: Maternity is a permanent exclusion (Code Excl18) under this policy.

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB accrues at 25% flat per claim-free year, capped at 100% of SI. Optional Benefit: NCB Super adds additional 50%/yr up to 100% of SI on top of NCB. Optional Benefit: Modification of No Claim Bonus reduces NCB to 10%/yr capped at 50%.

restoration.note: Automatic Recharge reinstates base SI once per policy year after full exhaustion; usable for same or different illness. Optional Benefit: Unlimited Automatic Recharge upgrades to unlimited restorations.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission. Optional Benefit: Modification of Pre/Post Hospitalization reduces this to 30 days.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge. Optional Benefit: Modification reduces this to 60 days.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to Sum Insured.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered via reimbursement only; must exceed 3 consecutive days. Certain diseases (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.) excluded under this benefit.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to Sum Insured at registered AYUSH hospitals; admissible only if In-patient Care claim is also admissible.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor medical expenses covered up to SI for harvesting surgery; pre/post hospitalisation for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered; exact rupee limit specified in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance available as optional add-on.

modern_treatments.display: Covered up to SI (12 listed procedures)
modern_treatments.note: Advance Technology Methods (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemo, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to SI. Optional Benefit: Sub-limit on Advance Technology Methods can cap these.

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable items are listed as excluded in Annexure I. No inbuilt or optional consumables cover rider found.

global_cover.note: Policy covers medical treatment taken entirely within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no claim can be contested except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly premium mode.

free_look.note: Free-look period of 30 days from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies only.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, hormone replacement therapy, tobacco/alcohol-related illness, external congenital anomaly, mental retardation, alopecia, external prosthetics, domiciliary for 12 listed chronic diseases

optional_riders.display: Room Rent upgrade, Unlimited Recharge, NCB Super, OPD Care, OPD Consultation & Therapy, Air Ambulance, Accidental SI top-up, Critical Illness SI top-up, Instant Cover (PED waiver), Smart Select, Disease Management Programs
